Author: Sanaka
Name: Eorzea Arsenal
Description: Reads your gearsets across all jobs and pushes them to your Eorzea Arsenal account so the web app can show your gear vs BiS, and can optionally upload which equippable items you own (inventory + retainers). Connect once (browser approval or paste an API key), then use /xivarsenal. Bilingual DE/EN. Using Dalamud violates the FFXIV ToS; all uploads are strictly opt-in.
Punchline: Push your gearsets to Eorzea Arsenal to compare them against BiS.

Author: Sanaka
Name: Fate Compass
Description: Lists the active FATEs in your current zone, ranks them by distance, remaining time, and progress, and shows the nearest aetheryte for each one. Adds a flag button for sharing a target with your party and an optional single trigger for the small preparation steps around entering a FATE. The plugin never plays for you.
Punchline: Find, rank, and reach FATEs without the busywork.

Author: Sanaka
Name: Gearbook
Description:
The game lists your gearsets by name and nothing else. Gearbook adds what that list is missing: a search, filters by role and category, favourites, your own tags and notes, and a compact bar of job icons you can leave on screen and click to switch. A switcher on the front of the bar swaps it between your favourites, one role, one category or one of your own tags without opening a window.

It is built for the case the game handles worst, several sets for the same job, so a dark knight for one fight, another for a different one, and a third for a glamour are three separate entries rather than one guess. Rename them, reorder them, delete one, and your tags and notes stay on the right sets.

It can also tidy the game's own gearset list into the order Gearbook shows, which is the one thing it changes rather than reads. That runs only when you press the button, keeps the order it found so you can put it back, and stops at the first move that does not land where it was aimed.

Otherwise nothing happens on its own. Gearbook switches a gearset only when you click or type, and there is no automation, no queueing and no acting on your behalf while you are away. It needs no account, no server and no internet connection. Nothing leaves your machine.
Punchline: Every gearset, sorted, filtered, one click to switch.
